_meta.purpose: APPROXIMATE public/domain lat-long for STP-WAP / MDO-PHR corridor + STP-WAP outage->binding watch-list, for dashboard map viz only.
_meta.source: Public/domain knowledge of large, well-documented ERCOT facilities. NOT from datalake (datalake metadata has NO coordinates, ZONE only). NOT CEII. Do NOT treat as exact substation coordinates.
_meta.author: congestion-analyst
_meta.zone_field: ERCOT congestion zone as tagged in datalake metadata (HOUSTON/SOUTH). Note several SOUTH-tagged facilities are geographically south-central (Austin/La Grange/San Antonio area).
_meta.confidence: high = town/plant location well known to ~1-3 mi; medium = correct community/area, exact bus uncertain; low = approximate area only

facilities.name: WA PARISH
facilities.note: NRG W.A. Parish, Smithers Lake / Thompsons, Fort Bend Co. SW Houston injection node. TO-end (sink) of both monitored lines.

facilities.name: SOUTH TEXAS PROJECT
facilities.note: STP nuclear, Matagorda Co. coast (Wadsworth/Bay City). FROM-end (source) of STP-WAP, highest +SF.

facilities.name: PH ROBINSON
facilities.note: CenterPoint PH Robinson switching stn, Bacliff/Galveston Bay. Gen retired ~2018, now transmission node.

facilities.name: MEADOW
facilities.note: CenterPoint Meadow 345kV stn, SE Houston (~17.4 mi NW of PHR per CNP). Exact bus location not public-confirmed.

facilities.name: HILLJE
facilities.note: Hillje community, Wharton Co. Coastal 345 hub (BLU-HLJ, BLY-HLJ, HLJ-WAP, STP-HLJ). Chronic parallel-out.

facilities.name: BLESSING
facilities.note: Town of Blessing, Matagorda Co. DBLBYWF5 contingency family. BLY-WAP / BLY-HLJ 345.

facilities.name: ELM CREEK
facilities.note: Elm Creek 345 stn, Elmendorf/SE San Antonio (CPS area). STP-ELMCREEK; links MARION/SKYLINE/SANMIGUEL/HILLCTRY.

facilities.name: REFUGIO
facilities.note: Town of Refugio, Refugio Co. STP-REF 345 (REFSTP27) = likely DSTPREF5 contingency.

facilities.name: WHITE POINT
facilities.note: White Point, San Patricio Co. (Corpus Christi bay). STP-WHITE_PT; 'WP' sink token in DWPWFWP5.

facilities.name: DOW
facilities.note: Dow Chemical Freeport, Brazoria Co. STP-DOW; high +SF coastal injector.

facilities.name: BELLAIRE
facilities.note: Bellaire, inner SW Houston. BI-WAP 345 outlet.

facilities.name: SAN MIGUEL
facilities.note: San Miguel power plant, Atascosa Co. ElmCreek linkage.

facilities.name: MARION
facilities.note: Marion, Guadalupe Co. (NE of San Antonio). ElmCreek linkage.

facilities.name: NORTHBELT
facilities.note: North Belt area N Houston (Greenspoint). KG-NB 345 (DKG_NB_5, MDO-PHR contingency).

facilities.name: LYTTON SPRINGS
facilities.note: Lytton Springs community, Caldwell Co. (S of Austin). AT2H xfmr out -> STP-WAP lift 3.2.

facilities.name: FAYETTE
facilities.note: Fayette / LCRA Power Project, La Grange, Fayette Co. Plant-1 out -> STP-WAP lift 3.0.

facilities.name: HUTTO
facilities.note: Hutto, Williamson Co. (NE of Austin). Brkr/DSC out -> STP-WAP lift 2.6. (Datalake zone=SOUTH despite central geography.)

facilities.name: JEANETTA
facilities.note: Jeanetta CenterPoint stn, SW Houston (Westwood/Sharpstown). AT1 xfmr out -> lift 2.55.

facilities.name: OASIS
facilities.note: OAS-WAP 345 (DOASWAP5, MDO-PHR). Exact Oasis switching-stn location not confidently known. UNPLACED.

facilities.name: OBRIEN
facilities.note: Highest STP-WAP lift (4.3) but small-n. CenterPoint Houston-area stn; exact location not confidently known. UNPLACED.

facilities.name: BRISITA
facilities.note: 2025-only single-episode (discount). Location not confidently known. UNPLACED.
